units.source_text: “我倒没有说‘你走吧’……”老板娘吞吞吐吐地说，

en.t: “I did not exactly tell him, ‘Go away’...” the landlady said hesitantly,

units.source_text: 别人忙得不可开交，他却常常泡在客人房间里闲聊天，

en.t: When everyone else is run off their feet, he is often in the guests' rooms chatting idly,
and when something urgent comes up, he is nowhere to be found.

units.source_text: 待久了，彼此都熟悉了，他人倒是蛮好，可就是……”

en.t: After staying here so long, we all know one another well, and he is a good person, but still...”
